title: 听力流程填空
goal: 按先后关系和条件对应流程步骤与产物。

points.label: 按先后关系定位流程步骤
辨认分支条件与步骤产物

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 听力流程填空与听力课教学规格

body.p: 流程图用箭头把起点、动作和产物连起来。在分支处，材料按条件进入不同的下一步。

body.box:
Collect samples → Dry samples → Sort by size
Small → store
Large → measure

body.p: Dry 在收集和分类之间。Small 和 Large 是分支条件，各接一个不同的动作。

steps.d: 先看流程从什么材料开始，箭头朝哪个方向。collect samples 是这张图的起点。
用 before、once 和 until 判断先后。录音有时先说后发生的动作。
把每个条件对应到一条箭头。small 的样本进入 store，large 的样本进入 measure。
分清操作用的工具和操作得到的结果。按题面的字数限制，写录音里的原词。

cards.title: 顺序与条件
rows: Dry the samples before sorting them.
前一个动作完成后，再做后一个
动作一直持续，到条件出现为止
Wait until the paper is dry.
条件决定下一步做什么

body.box:
Recording: Before the fragments are weighed, they are cleaned with a brush. Once weighed, they are placed in a box.

Cleaned with a brush → ______ → placed in a box

Write ONE WORD from the recording.

body.p: 答案是 weighed。before 说明先清洁、后称重。once 说明称重完成后才放进盒子。

use a sieve to collect powder
工具是 sieve，产物是 powder

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. The pieces are ______ before measurement.
items.why: 依据是 Before the pieces are measured, they are washed。测量之前先洗，答案是 washed。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. After the labels are checked, the boxes are ______.
items.why: 依据是 Once the labels are checked, the boxes are sealed。核对标签之后封箱，答案是 sealed。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Wet paper → leave on the ______.
items.why: 依据是 If the paper is wet, leave it on the rack。湿纸这条分支接的是 rack。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Separate mixture with a sieve → collect ______.
items.why: 依据是 leaving powder to be collected。sieve 是工具，分离后收集的产物是 powder。

groups.text:
Collect fragments → wash → (1) → sort by size
Small → (2)
Large → measure → record in (3)

lines.text: This demonstration describes the treatment of fragments collected for a teaching collection. First the fragments are collected and placed in a tray. The next step is to wash them gently in clean water. Before sorting begins, the fragments must be dried. They remain on a rack until their surfaces are dry. Once drying is complete, the class sorts the fragments by size. In this example there are two categories: small and large. If a fragment is small, it goes into a labelled envelope for storage. If it is large, the class measures its length with a ruler. The measurement is then entered in a notebook. The ruler is the tool used to measure length; the notebook is where the resulting measurement is recorded. The envelope is used only for the small category in this particular procedure. Each label identifies the collection from which the fragment came. The order matters because wet fragments are harder to handle and may damage paper envelopes. Washing and drying also happen before the size categories are assigned. A flow chart can show the common steps in a single line, then divide into two arrows at the sorting stage. Each arrow should carry its condition, small or large, and lead to the appropriate next action. The completed chart is a record of this procedure rather than a rule for every kind of collection.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. After washing, the fragments are ______.
items.why: 依据是 Before sorting begins, the fragments must be dried。清洗之后、分类之前是干燥，答案是 dried。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Small fragments are stored in an ______.
items.why: 依据是 If a fragment is small, it goes into a labelled envelope。小碎片这条分支接的是 envelope。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Measurements of large fragments are recorded in a ______.
items.why: 依据是 The measurement is then entered in a notebook。ruler 是测量工具，记录的地方是 notebook。

groups.text:
Collect water → (1) → filter → inspect liquid
If clear → pour into (2)
If cloudy → filter again → record result in (3)

lines.text: Today we will follow a classroom procedure for examining a water sample. First, the class collects water in a clean container. Before filtering it, the students stir the water so that material in the container is mixed. They then pour the sample through a paper filter. The filter retains some visible material, and the liquid passes into a second container. Once filtering has finished, the class inspects the liquid. If the liquid looks clear, it is poured into a bottle and labelled. If it remains cloudy, the class filters it again using a fresh piece of paper. The result of that second filtering is recorded in a notebook. The bottle and the notebook have different functions: one holds liquid, while the other holds a written observation. Looking clear does not show that water is safe to drink. This demonstration concerns visible appearance only, and none of the samples is consumed. A flow chart can show collection, stirring and filtering as the shared first steps. It then divides at the inspection, because the next action depends on the observed appearance. The branch for clear liquid ends with labelling the bottle. The branch for cloudy liquid includes another filtering step and a written record. The arrows show the order of actions, while the labels on the branches identify the condition for each route. This makes the procedure easier to reconstruct from the record.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Before filtering, the students ______ the water.
items.why: 依据是 Before filtering it, the students stir the water。过滤之前的动作是 stir。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Clear liquid is poured into a ______.
items.why: 依据是 If the liquid looks clear, it is poured into a bottle。清澈这条分支接的是 bottle。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. After cloudy liquid is filtered again, the result is recorded in a ______.
items.why: 依据是 The result of that second filtering is recorded in a notebook。bottle 装液体，记录结果的是 notebook。

groups.text:
Choose survey site → mark area → count plants → (4)
If label is missing → add (5)
If label is present → store record in (6)

lines.text: A simple plant survey can be organised as a sequence of steps. First, the students choose a site. They then mark out the area to be studied, using the same shape and size at each site. After marking the area, they count the plants within it. Once the count is complete, they photograph the area. Each photograph is paired with a written record of the count. Before storing the record, the students check its label. If the site label is missing, they add the label before storage. If it is already present, they place the record directly in a folder. The folder holds the record; the photograph provides a visual record of the area. The count is a separate observation and can be compared with counts from other marked areas. The class uses the same boundaries and counting rule so that the records are comparable. A photograph can help the class revisit what was visible, but it does not automatically replace the written count. The survey is a teaching exercise and its results apply to the areas examined. A flow chart shows the shared steps from site selection to checking the label. At the checking stage, two arrows represent the two conditions. Both routes eventually lead to storage, but only the route for a missing label requires an additional action. Recording this branch makes the sequence clear to another group repeating the exercise.

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. Once the count is complete, students ______ the area.
items.why: 依据是 Once the count is complete, they photograph the area。计数之后是拍照，答案是 photograph。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. If the site label is missing, students add the ______.
items.why: 依据是 If the site label is missing, they add the label before storage。缺标签这条分支要补上 label。

items.stem: Write ONE WORD. A record with a label is placed directly in a ______.
items.why: 依据是 If it is already present, they place the record directly in a folder。有标签的记录直接放进 folder。
